subject: Idea for DeepL's outreach flow
body:
Hi DeepL team,

I noticed deepL positions itself as an AI language platform spanning translation, voice, and API products. That often points to a need for keeping inbound qualification and follow-up more consistent around AI-assisted lead enrichment and outreach.

I work on AI-assisted lead enrichment and outreach for teams that want outreach to stay relevant, structured, and easier to hand off internally.

If useful, I can send a short tailored teardown for DeepL and where this could help. Would a 10-minute intro next week be useful?

Best,
Mikhail
